description: Runs one prompt through up to 4 model personas and returns each answer verbatim, with real citations when webSearch is on. The four persona labels (chat_gpt/claude/gemini/perplexity) are NOT vendor-verified — none is guaranteed to be that vendor's own model; 'claude' and 'perplexity' in particular have no real vendor route at all. Treat every answer as 'a model answering as X', never as ground truth from X. REQUIRES A PAID PLAN and CHARGES one shared AI-gateway operation per call (not per model) — plus one more if analyzeSentiment and highlightBrand are BOTH set.

analyzeSentiment.description: Classify sentiment toward highlightBrand in each answer. Requires highlightBrand. Spends one EXTRA AI-gateway operation on top of the base call — never charged unless both this and highlightBrand are set.

highlightBrand.description: A brand/entity name to highlight mentions of in each answer. Required for analyzeSentiment.

models.description: 1-4 model personas to answer the prompt (chat_gpt, claude, gemini, perplexity). See this tool's own description for what these labels do and do not guarantee.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to each requested model.

webSearch.description: Ground the answer in a real retrieval pass with cited sources, shared across every requested persona. Defaults to true.

name: explore_ai_prompt
